# Halftone dossier recipe

## Look
Think of an old printed police dossier. Cream filing paper. A handful of flat inks printed over each other as halftone dots. Giant bold headlines whose shadows sit slightly off. Rubber stamps hitting the page. Characters in thick outlines. The video reads the file out loud, exhibit after exhibit.

## Principles
- The whole frame is paper: a warm cream sheet with fine grain, a vignette and a fold down the centre. Dark scenes are printed on that same sheet. Nothing glows.
- Gradients are banned for shading. Use halftone dots instead, sized by a density field. Stack two or three dot layers at differing screen angles and multiply them: this is what makes it look printed.
- Paperwork furniture: case numbers, file chips, numbered counts, a height chart, a name plate, stamps. The solemn format is the frame, which lets the subject be grave or trivial.
- Loud, still readable: per 2-4 s card, one idea, one big headline, one visual gag, one caption line.
- Not this: a two-ink zine (grainy two-ink collage as the entire look), Swiss kinetic type on white, candy game-show sets. Every frame shows dots, paper, and a stamp or chip.

## Build
- Paper layer: a single half-resolution image (per-pixel warm noise, radial vignette, faint centre fold), multiplied over everything, built once.
- Halftone: a rotated grid of circles, drawn once per scene into a backdrop image.
  - Step 20-26 px; a different screen angle for each layer.
  - Radius = density x step x k, with k between 0.6 and 0.72. Around 0.7, neighbouring dots fuse into solid ink.
  - Density sources: radial (halos, corner glows) or edge (dots piling up along the frame border).
  - The second layer multiplies, so inks overprint. On a dark ground it stacks normally so it stays visible.
- Halftone-filled numerals and shapes: a flat fill with a darker halftone path clipped to the glyph. A giant numeral bleeds off the frame.
- Characters and props: chunky shapes, 7 px ink outline, flat fills, a lighter belly, glossy eyes (ink ellipse plus highlight) that blink, squint, or close into a happy arc. Props (bubbles, starbursts, folders, desks) are flat fill plus ink outline.
- Stamps: a double rounded rectangle with bold caps in warning red, about 93% opacity, tilted +-10 degrees.

## Palette
- `--latar`: the paper. `--teks`: the single dark ink, for outlines, body text and the caption bar. `--utama`: the big field and dot ink (opening wipe, halos). `--aksen`: highlights (numerals, key words, the folder). `--aksen-di-latar`: small key words.
- Fixed in every brand: the overprint shadow ink `--cetak` (hot pink), the stamp red `--merah`, paper fibre, and the characters' local colours (body green, leaf green, pot orange).
- Flat inks only. Tone comes from dot size and overprint. Five inks plus paper at most.
- Dark brands: lighten the paper multiply and let dot layers stack normally.

## Type
- `--font-judul`: a black-weight serif ("Libre Baskerville" 700 or "Playfair Display"), 110-200 px, left-aligned near the margin. Misregistration shadow: -9/+7 px in `--cetak`, or +8/+8 in `--aksen`.
- Title word and big numerals: fat rounded display ("Fredoka" 700, 100-330 px). HUD and case numbers: mono ("IBM Plex Mono" 600, 22-28 px). `--font-isi`: black sans ("Archivo Black") for captions, stamps and info lines, 36 px.
- Cards double as subtitles. Each beat gets a headline and a caption bar. The bar is a rounded pill in dark ink with a pink offset shadow; text in paper colour; the key word sits on a highlight block. It appears after the headline and lingers at least 1.8 s.
- HUD: case number and chapter chip top-left; REC dot and date top-right.

## Motion
- Every entrance overshoots (`back.out(1.9)`, 0.3-0.45 s), rising from below or scaling up from 0. Nothing fades in.
- Per-letter pop: each glyph rises 60-90 px while scaling from 0, staggered 0.05-0.07 s (0.02 for small text).
- Squash on landing preserves volume: `scale(1/sq, sq)` with a damped cosine. Title letters fall 700 px in 0.2 s, 0.25 s apart.
- Stamp slam: 0.09 s, from 2.6x down to 1x (ease-in), then a 5% damped bounce. Shake and flash fire on that same frame.
- Idle life: blinks at scripted times, REC dot at 2 Hz, a 0.6% beat pulse every 0.5 s.
- Dot wipe: a coarse 80 px grid of circles swells to full cover and shrinks away in 0.44 s with a diagonal delay. Each cut gets its own ink. Switch the scene while covered.

## Camera
- Locked frontal with a 0.6% beat pulse: the page as poster. For a title, list, accusation.
- Slow push-in 1 to 1.05 over 4 s: scrutiny. For a profile, or a recap ahead of the verdict.
- Shake decaying quadratically (5-16 px over 0.2-0.3 s): impact. For a stamp, spill, landing.
- Flash (white, at most 0.95 fading to 0 in 0.3 s; 0.5 for big hits): being photographed. For a mugshot or verdict.
- Dot wipe or hard cut: next file. For a new chapter or a second case.

Lay out like a printed page: headline top-left, subject right of centre, caption bar bottom-centre, HUD in the corners. No dissolves.

## Signature moves
- Accusation frame. Frame the topic as "the case of X" and list the counts. A bad habit on trial; city traffic; a plant forever wilting.
- The mugshot. Subject faces front, with a height chart, a name plate and a camera flash. A new product; a pet channel's star; the suspect in a bug report.
- Numbered count. A giant halftone numeral sits behind each beat, and a counter ticks up. Five recipe steps; three contract clauses; lesson 02 of a class.
- The stamp. A verdict arrives as a physical slam. APPROVED on a grant; LUNAS on an invoice; SOLVED on a riddle.
- Dot density as emotion. Halos bloom for joy; dots crowd the edges for tension. A record broken; a closing deadline; a reunion.

## Pitfalls
- Fonts that are not loaded before layout throw per-letter positions off. Use only faces declared by `@font-face`.
- A dot step under about 14 px turns to moire after encoding.
- A 100% white flash looks like a dropped frame. Cap big hits near 0.5.
- If a dot wipe has not fully covered the frame at the cut, the hard switch shows. Make the radius reach the cell diagonal.
- Keep stamps and captions off contact lines and prices.
- Too many inks kill the print feel.

# Case file: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2, medium 3, long 4.

## hook

- en: on a main-colour field with halftone edges, the name's fat letters drop one by one and squash; the subject peeks over them
- id: di bidang warna utama bertepi raster, huruf nama jatuh satu per satu lalu memipih; tokoh mengintip dari baliknya

## problem

- en: the charge pops in letter by letter, the big line with a misregistered shadow; a rubber stamp slams with a shake
- id: dakwaan muncul per huruf, baris besar berbayang meleset; stempel karet menghentak, layar bergetar

## fact

- en: a mugshot: the subject rises before a height chart in a halftone halo, name plate below, two camera flashes
- id: foto tersangka: tokoh naik di depan garis tinggi dalam halo raster, papan nama di bawah, dua kilat kamera

## step

- en: one numbered count per step: a giant halftone numeral bleeds off the right, headline left, caption bar below
- id: satu dakwaan bernomor per langkah: angka raster raksasa keluar kanan, judul di kiri, bilah teks di bawah

## compare

- en: two exhibit cards drop in tilted and pinned, each with an icon; a stamp marks the guilty one
- id: dua kartu barang bukti jatuh miring dan disematkan, masing-masing berikon; stempel menandai yang bersalah

## number

- en: a counter by the giant numeral ticks up on the gag's impact, pumps in the accent and a starburst pops
- id: hitungan di samping angka raksasa naik tepat saat lelucon terjadi, membesar dalam warna aksen, ledakan muncul

## proof

- en: the evidence on a profile sheet: fields slide in beside the subject, the key word in the accent
- id: bukti di lembar profil: data meluncur masuk di samping tokoh, kata kuncinya berwarna aksen

## offer

- en: the offer on a caption bar under a big headline; the key word on an accent block, a stamp seals it
- id: penawaran di bilah teks di bawah judul besar; kata kunci di blok aksen, stempel mengesahkannya

## cta

- en: the case folder rises with name and contact on its label; a verdict stamp slams, a speech bubble pops, held 2 s
- id: map berkas naik dengan nama dan kontak di labelnya; stempel vonis menghentak, gelembung bicara muncul, diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: the verdict: one stamp slams with a flash and shake over the closed folder, then holds 2 s
- id: vonis: satu stempel menghentak dengan kilat dan getar di atas map yang ditutup, lalu diam 2 detik
